sheets.beats: TOP ROW: wide shot of tiny Ruby hiding beneath a dusty wooden pantry shelf while dark purple hungry shadows approach far behind her and a warm sunbeam enters a crack. MIDDLE ROW: intimate close shot of Ruby's stubby hands clutching her little worn brown recipe book against her round pink chest, tiny trembling mouth and ruby gem visible; pantry shelves softly out of focus. BOTTOM ROW: a new medium close view of Ruby lifting her hopeful big eyes toward the bright crack in the pantry, holding the book and reaching one tiny hand toward incoming warm light. Clear progression: fear, precious memory, hope.
sheets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production art sheet for a cozy fantasy mobile story comic. OUTPUT ONE PORTRAIT CANVAS aspect 2:3, divided into EXACTLY THREE equal horizontal rows. Each row is a DISTINCT WIDE 2:1 event illustration. Three rows fill the canvas edge to edge. Row boundaries EXACTLY at one-third and two-thirds height; no gutter, no frame, no captions, no text, no numbers, no speech bubbles. Do NOT draw a single continuous scene across rows. Each row is a different camera shot, a clear sequential story beat. sheets.beats: TOP ROW: gentle elderly round mochi grandmother with white hair bun stirs red jam in a copper pot in a cozy golden kitchen, tiny Ruby watches lovingly with her recipe book. MIDDLE ROW: dynamic close shot of one ruby-red jam jar with cream-red cloth cover tumbling into a narrow cracked pantry floor, above-ground warm kitchen contrasted with purple dark crack, no Ruby needed. BOTTOM ROW: low close view inside an old curved drainage pipe, the same intact jam jar rests glowing red in darkness while wispy black-purple Hunger fingers reach from far behind without touching it; a single warm reflection leads deeper. Clear progression: beloved kitchen memory, jar lost, follow the clue.

sheets.beats: TOP ROW: wide clear view of crooked underground copper furnace and pipes burning bright rainbow ribbons of stolen flavor drawn from a row of jam jars, orange and purple palette. MIDDLE ROW: close detailed shot of one glass jar as its bright strawberry-red flavor ribbon is pulled out through a copper pipe, neighboring jars pale and empty, tender sadness. BOTTOM ROW: Ruby in medium close view beside machinery, eyes closed as a tiny red fragrant wisp curls toward her gem; she holds her recipe book, expression changing from alarm to a fragile remembered smile. Clear progression: discover the machine, see what it steals, sense a familiar flavor.

sheets.beats: TOP ROW: imposing wide shot of ancient crown-shaped gold bake oven over a broken stone walkway, red fire light and an abstract black-purple swirl deep in its mouth, no monster face. MIDDLE ROW: intimate medium view of Ruby at edge of the walkway, frightened but holding her little brown recipe book tightly against her round body, gem dimly glowing against dark purple background. BOTTOM ROW: from behind tiny Ruby as she takes a brave step onto the path toward the towering Crown Oven; warm ruby light spreads ahead from her gem and the book, clear silhouette, facing the danger together. Clear progression: arrive, admit fear, find courage.
